long_biography.plain_text:
Muvico's themed megaplexes made the cinema building part of the entertainment. Hamid Hashemi used elaborate architecture and stadium seating to distinguish the chain, later extending that focus on experience at IPIC through smaller auditoriums, reclining seats and full-service dining.

The concept grew from an unexpected theatre acquisition that redirected a microbiology graduate and property entrepreneur into movie exhibition. Hashemi sold an early group of cinemas before launching a larger Muvico chain, then returned after leaving it to found IPIC. He subsequently led product and experience at WeWork, applying the same interest in communal space to offices. After WeWork, he advised businesses across property, retail, healthcare and hospitality while developing Studio Social, an art-making concept intended to create in-person community.
